items.quote: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him
items.claim: The sons of Aaron brought blood to the priest

items.quote: he dipped his finger in the blood
items.claim: Aaron dipped his finger in the blood

items.quote: put it upon the horns of the altar
items.claim: Aaron put blood on the altar horns

items.quote: poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar
items.claim: Aaron poured blood at the altar base

items.quote: the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar
items.claim: Aaron burned the sacrificial parts on the altar
items.object: the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering

items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses regarding the ritual procedures
